Introduction
This document outlines the monthly maintenance steps I1, M1, for the make-up pump, which is the pump responsible for maintaining the water pressure inside the fire-fighting lines at 165 psi; the pump starts if the pressure inside the lines reaches 150 psi; there are 2 pumps:
- The first starts at 150 psi and stops at 165 psi.
- The second starts at 145 psi and stops at 150 psi.

Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority, and follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment.
Those carrying out the maintenance work must hold an occupational safety and health category card.
Cordon off the area to define the work area, and place warning signs.
Wear personal protective equipment ( safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls , gloves ..... ).
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically.
Close the suction and discharge valves.

4. | Test the 
 Pressure Switch
 inside the pump control panel 
 if necessary.
5. | Inspect any leaks from the suction and discharge valves.
6. | Make sure there are no vibrations, and check the fastening of the main bolts.
7. | Make sure the motor shaft is aligned with the pump shaft.
